title: smol brains
pitch: an island of tiny creatures with real neural-network brains. they evolve, invent fire, build villages and pray to you. they will learn the wrong things.
controls: drag to pan, pinch or wheel to zoom, twist or right-drag to rotate. tools: grab (carry, throw), tickle (reward), tap (scold), talk (teach words), magic (miracles). wasd pan, q/e rotate, 1-5 tools, space pause, [ ] speed, b brain viewer.
how_to: tap the egg to warm it, then teach a first word: pick 💬 talk and tap an apple a few times. smols learn nouns before verbs.
tickle right after the good thing. a few seconds late rewards whatever it is doing by then, which is how smols learn weird superstitions.
stuck on an evolution? the goal strip says which gene is missing. ✨ magic → 🧬 bless makes the next eggs lean that way.
tool-users invent things on their own. 💡 inspire speeds it up, and smols teach each other. if the last smol who knows an idea dies, it's gone.
the brain viewer (b) is the cheat code: watch which action lights up and you'll know what to tickle or scold.
share your world: smolpedia → world → copy world link. anyone who opens it gets the same island.
